camel_example: aliyun ehpc ListNodesByQueue --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --PageNumber 1 --Async false --QueueName workq
description_en: Queries the node information of a single cluster within an Alibaba Cloud account by queue
description_zh: 按队列分组查询用户账户下单个集群的节点信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-nodes-by-queue --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name workq --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByQueue

parameters.help_en: The ID of the E-HPC cluster
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的行数。取值范围：1~50

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable asynchronous query
parameters.name: async

AddTime.description_en: The time when the node was added to the cluster

CreateMode.description_en:
The mode in which the node is created. Valid values:

manual: The node is manually added.
autoscale: The node is automatically added
CreateMode.description_zh:
节点创建方式。可能值：
manual：手动扩容
autoscale：自动扩容

CreatedByEhpc.description_en: Indicates whether the node was created by using E-HPC

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the subscription node has expired. If the node is a pay-as-you-go node, false is returned
Expired.description_zh: 包年包月节点是否到期。如果是按量付费节点，则为false

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the subscription instance expires. If the node is a pay-as-you-go node, a null value is returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 包年包月节点到期时间。如果是按量付费节点，则此项为空

ImageOwnerAlias.description_en:
The type of the image. Valid values:

system: public image
self: custom image
others: shared image
marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image
ImageOwnerAlias.description_zh:
镜像类型，可能值：
system：公共镜像
self：自定义镜像
others：共享镜像
marketplace：镜像市场镜像

IpAddress.description_en: The private IP address of the node

Location.description_en:
The location where the node is deployed. Valid values:

OnPremise: The cluster is deployed on a hybrid cloud.
PublicCloud: The cluster is deployed on a public cloud
Location.description_zh:
节点所在位置。可能值：
OnPremise：混合云集群。
PublicCloud：公有云集群

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the node is locked. Valid values:

financial: The instance is locked due to overdue payments.
security: The node is locked for security reasons.
recycling: The preemptible instance is locked and pending release.
dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked due to overdue payments of the dedicated host.

By default, an empty string is returned
LockReason.description_zh:
节点被锁定类型，可能值：
financial：因欠费被锁定。
security：因安全原因被锁定。
recycling：抢占式实例的待释放锁定状态。
dedicatedhostfinancial：因为专有宿主机欠费导致ECS实例被锁定。

默认返回为空字符串

PublicIpAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the node

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy of the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: The instance is created as a pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: The instance is created as a preemptible instance with a user-defined maximum hourly price.
SpotAsPriceGo: The instance is created as a preemptible instance for which the market price at the time of purchase is automatically used as the bid price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
实例的抢占策略。可能值：
NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格

StateInSched.description_en: The status of the node displayed on the scheduler. The status varies with the scheduler
StateInSched.description_zh: 从调度器查看到的节点状态，不同调度器状态不同

Status.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

uninit: The node is not initialized.
init: The node is being initialized.
ready: The node is ready.
running: The cluster is running.
exception: An exception occurred on the node.
untracking: The node is not added to the cluster
Status.description_zh:
节点状态。可能值：
uninit：未初始化
init：初始化中
ready：空闲
running：运行中
exception：异常
untracking：未加入集群

TotalResources.description_en: The number of all resources in the cluster

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPU cores. Unit: cores

Gpu.description_en: The total number of GPU cards. Unit: cards

UsedResources.description_en: The usage of the compute nodes in the cluster. For other types of nodes, an empty value is returned
UsedResources.description_zh: 计算节点资源使用量，其他类型节点返回值为空

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPU cores. Unit: cores

Gpu.description_en: The total number of GPU cards. Unit: cards

Version.description_en: The version of the E-HPC client
Version.description_zh: 集群所使用的客户端版本号

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID of the node

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the node

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
